verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo Agents are documented to turn issues into merge requests, remediate vulnerabilities, and review code, indicating a built-in AI assistant users can delegate tasks to, and an MCP server further supports agentic workflows. However, evidence lacks depth on how tasks are delegated in-product, independent hands-on verification of agent reliability, or detail on scope/limits. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent corroboration of the agent's task delegation in practice, more detail on assistant UX/capabilities beyond marketing copy.
